model_annotation: Figure 2 presents negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant token between baseline Mistral-0.2 and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The horizontal axis displays the specialty names – Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics – listed in alphabetical order, with no apparent sorting of the bars. The vertical axis is labeled “Negative log-probability” and represents a linear scale ranging from 4.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For each specialty, there are two bars presented side-by-side: a blue bar representing the baseline Mistral-0.2 model and a gray bar representing the fine-tuned model. The blue bars range in height from approximately 4.4 for Pediatrics to 5.6 for Gastro, while the gray bars range from approximately 4.2 for Pediatrics to 5.2 for Cardio. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
